confidence_note: The book's central image (cows by the road are remarkable at first and then invisible; a purple cow would be remarkable; remarkable means worth remarking on) is confirmed by summaries. That the setting was a family trip through the French countryside is recalled from the book's introduction but not confirmed by a source read in this session; the story says 'a drive through the French countryside' and says no more about who was in the car. Omitted: time spans, numbers of cows, names of products and brands the book lists.
facts: Seth Godin's image: on a drive through the French countryside, the cows by the road were interesting at first and then, after enough of them, faded into the scenery.
A purple cow would be different: you would notice it and mention it.
Godin calls something worth remarking on 'remarkable' and says that is what makes people talk.
His argument: advertising for an ordinary product competes with endless other ads, so the product itself has to be worth noticing.
Godin argues that playing it safe is the risky path, because a safe, ordinary product disappears into the field.
scene_details: a drive through the French countryside
cows by the road that stop being noticed
tension: Something fascinating becomes invisible after a few repetitions, and marketing keeps adding more of the same.
opening_idea: Open on cows by a French road, interesting at first and then part of the view.

lessons.idea: Ask whether your product or message is worth mentioning before you spend on spreading it.
lessons.anchor: cows turning invisible while a purple one would be remarked on

reflect_final: What is the one thing about your work that someone would mention to a friend without being asked, and if there is none, what could it become?

use_cases.situation: A team plans a campaign budget.
use_cases.move: Say 'would anyone mention this to a friend?' before you decide how much to spend.

use_cases.situation: Preparing a talk or a portfolio.
use_cases.move: Pick the one detail you would be pleased to hear repeated and move it to the front.

use_cases.situation: Telling friends about your small shop or project.
use_cases.move: Describe the one thing about it that is not like the others, not the whole list.

pocket_idea: Cows by a French road stop being seen; Godin asks what in your work would still make someone turn their head.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Godin noticed the cows along a French road became invisible within minutes, and a purple one would not.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Seth Godin describes driving through the French countryside: the cows were interesting at first, then invisible. Marketing has the same problem. A purple cow would be worth mentioning, and Godin says that is the point: make something remarkable, because spending to advertise an ordinary product gets lost in the field.
